game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Northern Wall, the northern wall: the innkeeper must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the innkeeper calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Northern Wall: the northern wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Northern Wall, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the innkeeper calls throughout the level. Each round, blizzard sprites strike the watch bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the library value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the watch bell from blizzard sprites in Northern Wall: keep the library meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: library drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Library Builder' (Week 6 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Northern Wall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Northern Wall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 39 seconds while library > 0.
